about_the_game:
Pilot your rusty-but-trusty Zero-G fighter through forsaken, procedurally generated ruins where up and down lose any meaning. Battle enemy attack drones, scavenge weapon mods and shields to survive the descent into this insane underworld.

In this free demo version of Liha, you'll dive into the depths of the Cold Bunker, an old research and storage facility.

A space-ripping anomaly has torn it apart, leaving it broken, yet still the same. Watch out for the sentient flesh fungus! You'll have four different weapons at your disposal to tear through the infection and the machines, to collect valuable loot and hopefully make it out alive!

  • Zero-G Combat: Intense fights in all directions, against relentless enemy hoards and vicious mercenaries

  • Scavenge everything: Scrounge up enemy weapons and strap on mods to rain hell down on anything that moves.

  • Procedurally generated ruins: No descent into the anomaly is the same. Face brutal challenges that shift with every dive. There is always somebody wanting a piece of you!

  • Gritty atmosphere: Enter forsaken lost places where the only thing that matters is what you can get out of there - if you make it back alive.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: General Mature Content

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: a 2 Ghz Dual Core of any 64bit variety
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Sound Card: Your onboard soundcard will cut it
  • Additional Notes: The specs are preliminary
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 3.6 Ghz Intel i5 or comparable
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Sound Card: The oboard soundcard will do
